# Loupist {{version}}{{channel_suffix}}

Loupist for macOS 13 or newer on Apple Silicon. It never trades.

## What's in it
{{changelog}}

Signed with Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Updates use the Loupist updater key and require consent.
Verify downloads with SHA256SUMS and RELEASE-METADATA.json, and verify build provenance with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo loupistai/loupist`.

{{qualification}}
